name: postplan
description: An open-source alternative to Claude Artifacts for every coding agent — self-hosted on Cloudflare.
author: Plivo Inc.

scripts.dev: trap 'kill 0' SIGINT; bun run dev:api & bun run dev:content & bun run dev:web & wait
scripts.build:generated: cd packages/api && bun run build:annotate && bun run build:db && bun run build:agent-docs && bun run build:install && bun run build:whatsnew && bunx biome format --write src/annotate/bundle.ts src/postplandb/bundle.ts src/agent-docs.ts src/install-script.ts src/whats-new/catalog.ts
scripts.test: bun test scripts && bun run --filter '*' test
scripts.db:migrate:local: bunx wrangler d1 migrations apply postplan-db -c wrangler.jsonc --local --persist-to .wrangler-shared
scripts.db:migrate:remote: bunx wrangler d1 migrations apply postplan-db -c wrangler.jsonc --remote
scripts.deploy: scripts/apply-config.sh && bun run build:web && bunx wrangler deploy -c wrangler.jsonc && bunx wrangler deploy -c wrangler.content.jsonc
